constraints.description: A committed PostgreSQL mutation reaches existing v1 GetEntity and WatchEntity through real CDC, Iggy, and SurrealDB adapters.
Entity state and its source/broker cursor advance transactionally; inclusive snapshot/WAL overlap and restart replay are deduplicated without omission.

validation.validation_method: live snapshot overlap and adapter/projector restart scenarios

constraints.description: Delete clears current state and every watch event is reauthorized at object scope before payload delivery.

validation.validation_method: live delete and post-subscription revocation scenarios plus focused unit regression

constraints.description: The full deployment profile supplies pinned durable projection storage and fails fast on incomplete CDC projection configuration.

validation.validation_method: deployment renderer and gateway configuration tests

constraints.description: Formatting, diff hygiene, hand-authored file size, affected tests, all-target check, strict Clippy, strict OpenSpec, and independent adversarial review pass locally.

validation.validation_method: recorded local quality and review matrix

global_rules: Runtime tests execute locally; CI results are not evidence.
One adapter crate implements one application port.
The v1 protobuf wire contract remains unchanged.
The fixture owns and removes every PostgreSQL, Iggy, and SurrealDB resource it creates.
Source receipts bind candidate implementation and fixture files by SHA-256.
termination_conditions: Independent review has no unresolved critical or warning finding.
